description: The grouped bar chart illustrates “Performance” values for four metrics (EGP, TR-N, TR-S, CCP) when applying two decoding approaches (Greedy and RPG) to two LLM sizes (CodeLlama-7B and CodeLlama-34B), with performance reported as an average across three scenarios on the CodeRepetEval dataset. The horizontal axis is categorical and labeled “Metrics,” showing four categories in left-to-right order: “EGP ↑,” “TR-N ↓,” “TR-S ↓,” and “CCP ↑.” The vertical axis is a linear numeric scale labeled “Performance,” ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with regularly spaced tick marks at approximately 0.2 intervals. Each metric category contains four adjacent bars (grouped side-by-side), corresponding to the legend entries: Greedy (CodeLlama-7B) in blue, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) in orange, Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) in green, and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) in dark orange/red. For EGP, the blue bar is near 0.01, the orange bar is about 0.89, the green bar is about 0.59, and the dark orange/red bar is about 0.99. For TR-N, the blue bar is about 0.70, the orange bar about 0.46, the green bar about 0.62, and the dark orange/red bar about 0.40. For TR-S, the blue bar is about 0.68, the orange bar about 0.42, the green bar about 0.45, and the dark orange/red bar about 0.31. For CCP, the blue bar is about 0.40, the orange bar about 0.72, the green bar about 0.70, and the dark orange/red bar about 0.94. The bars are not visually sorted by magnitude, and there are no additional visual emphases such as outlines, annotations, or shading beyond the color legend.
